image_description: A highly ornate, gilded religious altar situated within a church sanctuary. The altar features a complex frontal structure with numerous tall, thin candles in silver or gold holders. Behind the candle arrangement is a large vertical panel depicting a religious figure (likely Jesus) with a halo, flanked by decorative columns and floral motifs. Above the central figure is a semi-circular arch with radiating light effects and Hebrew text. The entire structure is framed by an architectural niche with painted side panels.
